## Comprehensive Billing & Pricing System Report

I've thoroughly explored the Zip Code Checker Shopify app's pricing/billing infrastructure. Here's the complete breakdown:

---

## 1. PLAN DEFINITIONS (`app/plans.ts`)

### Plan IDs & Names
```typescript
PLAN_FREE = "free"
PLAN_PRO_MONTHLY = "Pro Monthly"
PLAN_PRO_ANNUAL = "Pro Annual"
PLAN_ULTIMATE_MONTHLY = "Ultimate Monthly"
PLAN_ULTIMATE_ANNUAL = "Ultimate Annual"
```

### Plan Limits (`PLAN_LIMITS` object)
| Plan     | Max Zip Codes | Blocked Zips | Label     |
|----------|---------------|--------------|-----------|
| **free** | 25            | ❌ No        | "Free"    |
| **pro**  | ∞ (Infinity)  | ✅ Yes       | "Pro"     |
| **ultimate** | ∞ (Infinity) | ✅ Yes     | "Ultimate"|

### Plan Tier Mapping Function
```typescript
getPlanTier(planName: string): "free" | "pro" | "ultimate"
```
- `"Pro Monthly"` or `"Pro Annual"` → `"pro"` tier
- `"Ultimate Monthly"` or `"Ultimate Annual"` → `"ultimate"` tier
- All other values → `"free"` tier

---

## 2. BILLING CONFIGURATION (`app/shopify.server.ts`)

### Pricing Structure
| Plan | Interval | Amount | Currency | Trial |
|------|----------|--------|----------|-------|
| **Pro Monthly** | Every 30 Days | $12.99 | USD | 14 days |
| **Pro Annual** | Annual | $99.00 | USD | 14 days |
| **Ultimate Monthly** | Every 30 Days | $24.99 | USD | 14 days |
| **Ultimate Annual** | Annual | $199.00 | USD | 14 days |

**Key Details:**
- All paid plans include a **14-day free trial** (no credit card charged until trial ends)
- Annual plans save 20% on monthly equivalent:
  - Pro: $12.99/mo × 12 = $155.88 vs $99/year (~36% savings)
  - Ultimate: $24.99/mo × 12 = $299.88 vs $199/year (~34% savings)
- Free plan: $0/month, forever

---

## 3. SUBSCRIPTION MANAGEMENT (`app/billing.server.ts`)

### ShopSubscription Interface
```typescript
interface ShopSubscription {
  planId: string;              // e.g., "Pro Monthly"
  planTier: "free" | "pro" | "ultimate";
  billingInterval: string;     // "monthly" or "annual"
  shopifySubscriptionId: string | null;
  status: string;              // "active", "pending", "cancelled"
  trialEndsAt: Date | null;
  limits: typeof PLAN_LIMITS[PlanTier];
}
```

### Key Functions

**`getShopSubscription(shop: string)`**
- Retrieves or creates subscription record for a shop
- Creates with defaults: `planId: "free"`, `billingInterval: "monthly"`, `status: "active"`
- Returns enriched `ShopSubscription` with limits

**`syncSubscriptionFromShopify(shop: string, appSubscriptions[])`**
- Syncs subscription from Shopify billing.check() result into database
- Finds ACTIVE subscription from Shopify
- Extracts plan name and subscription ID
- Auto-detects billing interval: "annual" if plan name contains "annual", else "monthly"
- Falls back to Free plan if no active subscription found

**`cancelShopSubscription(shop: string)`**
- Reverts shop to Free plan
- Clears `shopifySubscriptionId` and `billingInterval` to defaults

---

## 4. FEATURE GATING LOGIC

### Blocked Zip Codes Feature
**Location:** `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` (lines 139-145)

When a user tries to add/import a **blocked** zip code:
```javascript
if (type === "blocked" && !limits.allowBlocked) {
  return {
    error: "Blocked zip codes are not available on the Free plan. Upgrade to Pro or Ultimate.",
    upgradeRequired: true
  };
}
```

**Gated to:** Pro + Ultimate only
**Restricted on:** Free plan

### Zip Code Limit Enforcement
**Location:** `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` (lines 147-153)

When adding/importing a zip code on Free plan:
```javascript
const currentCount = await db.zipCode.count({ where: { shop } });
if (limits.maxZipCodes !== Infinity && currentCount >= limits.maxZipCodes) {
  return {
    error: `You have reached the ${limits.maxZipCodes} zip code limit for the Free plan. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited zip codes.`,
    upgradeRequired: true
  };
}
```

**Details:**
- Free plan: Hard limit at **25 zip codes**
- Pro/Ultimate: **Unlimited** zip codes
- Enforcement happens on:
  - Single add (`intent: "add"`)
  - Bulk import (`intent: "bulk-import"`)
  - Bulk import skips blocked zips if Free plan (lines 294-297)

---

## 5. UI/DASHBOARD GATING

### Dashboard (`app/routes/app._index.tsx`)

**Usage Bar (lines 248-267)**
- Only shown on **Free plan** when `limits.maxZipCodes !== Infinity`
- Displays zip code usage as % and progress bar
- Turns critical (red) at 80% usage

**Upgrade Prompt Banner (lines 273-286)**
- Shown on **Free plan** when usage ≥60% and not empty
- CTA: "Upgrade to Pro"
- Message highlights: unlimited zips, blocked zones, delivery rules

**Zip Code Stats Card (lines 195-269)**
- Shows total/allowed/blocked/waitlist/rules
- Free plan shows: `{total} / {maxZipCodes}` (e.g., "15 / 25")
- Pro/Ultimate shows: `{total} (Unlimited)`

### Pricing Page (`app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`)

**Plan Display Features:**
```javascript
const PLANS_DATA = {
  free: {
    features: [
      "Up to 25 zip codes",
      "Allowed zip codes only",
      "Basic storefront widget",
      "Standard email support",
    ]
  },
  pro: {
    features: [
      "Unlimited zip codes",
      "Allowed + Blocked zip codes",
      "Delivery zones & ETAs",
      "Bulk CSV import & export",
      "Customer waitlist",
      "Priority email support",
    ]
  },
  ultimate: {
    features: [
      "Everything in Pro",
      "Advanced delivery rules",
      "Customisable widget CSS",
      "API access",
      "24/7 VIP support",
      "Early access to new features",
    ]
  }
}
```

**Plan Card Logic (lines 203-334):**
- Detects upgrade/downgrade/switch actions
- Free users see: "Start 14-day free trial" for paid plans
- Paid users see: "Upgrade to {Plan}" or "Switch to {Plan}"
- Downgrade (paid → free) shows confirmation modal
- Annual plans show savings badge: "You save up to 36% per year"

**Downgrade Modal (lines 509-553):**
- Warns users about feature loss:
  - Unlimited → limited to 25 zip codes
  - Blocked zips disabled
  - Delivery zones/ETAs/rules disabled
  - Bulk import/export disabled
  - Waitlist disabled
- Notes: "Zip codes over 25 remain saved but become inactive"

### Settings Page (`app/routes/app.settings.tsx`)

## 6. DATABASE MODEL (`prisma/schema.prisma`)

```typescript
model Subscription {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String    @unique
  planId                String    @default("free")
  billingInterval       String    @default("monthly")
  shopifySubscriptionId String?
  status                String    @default("active")
  trialEndsAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
}
```

## 7. SUBSCRIPTION SYNC WEBHOOK

**Route:** `app/routes/webhooks.app_subscriptions.update.tsx`

- Receives Shopify `app_subscriptions/update` webhook
- Extracts: `id`, `name`, `status` from webhook payload
- Calls `syncSubscriptionFromShopify()` to update database
- Returns 200 immediately (non-blocking)
